newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco/China study nuclear powered desalination.
newsitem.headline: Morocco/China study nuclear powered desalination.

text.p: Morocco and China are to study the feasability of a nuclear-powered system of desalination plants on the Atlantic coast of the North African country.

Morocco's energy ministry and China's states' commission of sciences and technology have signed an agreement to look into the use of a 10 megawatt nuclear reactor, the official news agency MAP said on Monday.

The eight-month study, for which no costs were given, would focus on the idea of using a reactor to provide the necessary heat for a desalination unit, analysis of standards, impact on the environment, project cost estimates and how it could be financed, and a timetable for doing so.

"Recourse to desalination of seawater may provide an alternative source to cover the medium-term deficit of conventional water resources, particularly in regions in the south of the kingdom," MAP quoted the statement as saying.
The agreement was signed earlier this month, the agency said.
